visual_logic.color_palette: Bright lime-green with small sunflower-yellow spots; pale white underbelly.
visual_logic.texture: Glossy 'wet clay' finish; visible individual digits on the flipper ends (unlike the fully fused paddles of larger species).
visual_logic.action: The tiny Dallasaurus is shown darting through a cluster of clay sea-lilies, looking agile and curious.

environment.water: Bright, sun-drenched turquoise water with dancing caustic light patterns on the seafloor.
environment.biota: Stylized clay seagrass and small rising bubbles to emphasize its smaller scale.
